name: hydrocortisone + menthol + miconazole
uses: ■ For treatment of most athlete’s foot (tinea pedis), jock itch (tinea cruris), ringworm (tinea corporis), and superficial skin yeast infections (Candida albicans). ■ For temporary relief of itching, scaling, cracking, burning, redness, irritation and discomfort associated with these fungal skin conditions.
otcwarn: ■ On children under 2 years of age unless directed by a doctor. ■ For diaper rash. ■ On scalp or nails. ■ Condition worsens, symptoms persist more than 7 days or clear up and recur within a few days. ■ Irritation occurs. ■ No improvement within 4 weeks for athlete’s foot / ringworm, or within 2 weeks for jock itch.
